nodes.nie.text.t: "Too bad. I'll lie here in the ditch nursing my ankle. Maybe someone better will come along."

nodes.s.text.t: A wagon stands on the road, and by it a skinny saddler with a saddle on his back that reaches down to his knees. "Przybysław, saddler. I promised the scouts a saddle on the Merchants' Road, but I've turned my ankle on a root. Will you take it? They'll pay. Scouts always pay late, but they pay."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: Przybysław takes the saddle off his back and breathes like a man who's shaken off a debtor. "May your road run smooth and not trip you up. The scouts are camped on the road, where the merchants stop."
